deviations.what: The base window is built with fy + 0:base_years, so a patent's class is also counted in the base of its own filing year t, although the spec sets the base to t-5 through t-1 and excludes year t from both windows (the code's own comment on line 15 says fy+1 to fy+base_years).

notes: Dating on filing_year, the cpc_seq == 0 selection and first_listed_only switch, the missing-class filter, the forward window (fy-1 to fy-3), the anti-join for new classes, the NA-when-base-empty and 0-when-forward-empty rules, firm_year de-duplication and the output columns all match the spec. build.R does not restrict focal years to 1987-2015; under rule 11 the output follows firm_year, so that is left to the caller.
